**Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake.**

You meet all the standard eligibility requirements:
- You live in the UK
- Both children are under 16
- Both children live with you
- You are responsible for them
- None of the disqualifying circumstances apply

**Next steps:**
You can apply for Child Benefit if you haven't already done so. Only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child, so make sure no one else is claiming for Alex or Blake.

**Important note:** If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may need to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge. You can still claim Child Benefit but may need to pay back some or all of it through your tax return.
